title: Cancellation of ordered exchange at a complete input
statement: For the datum and chosen cartesian square of [def-weil-pbc-ordered-coefficient-comparison-data], at each object K of the full completed-coefficient derived-complete subcategory, rawComponent equals constantComponent. The raw component is restriction of completedExchange followed by iotaT, and the constant component is iotaS, S, derived limit of the constant strict mate, and T inverse, in that order. This is one pointwise equation and does not assert the other strict and reconstruction clauses.

source.place: Second paragraph, specified conjugating maps; agent-supplied strict coefficient comparison supplement. Ingredient sources only: proetale.tex Tag 099M (lemma-naive-completion), Tag 099N (lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case); sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0A07 (lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim), Tag 0E48 (remark-compatible-with-diagram). None states this combined comparison.

proof.text: Expand completedExchange as sourceA, derived limit of towerV', and targetA inverse, and apply restriction functoriality. Rewrite iotaT by the target reconstruction equation, which expresses it as restricted targetA, lambda, Rlim delta and T inverse; the restricted targetA inverse and targetA cancel. Naturality of lambda commutes restriction past derived limit of towerV'. The scalar strict-mate equation replaces Rlim of restricted towerV' followed by Rlim delta by Rlim beta followed by Rlim of the constant mate. The source reconstruction equation replaces restricted sourceA, lambda and Rlim beta by iotaS followed by S. The result is constantComponent. Every cancellation is by a specified isomorphism, so no new choice or finite evaluation argument is involved.
